commits.subject: C4 G4: add sparse measured macro synergy credit

ready_receipt_commit: The subsequent commit adding this file; discover with git log --oneline -- G4_READY.json
scope: G4 only: sparse measured synergy contracts, paired counterfactual job planning/executor seam, proposer-only trigger PPO integration, CPU tests and handoff documentation

api.registration(): Deep copy of the fixed common B/R registration, including weight/normalization/clipping/sampling/budget provenance
api.settings(cfg): Validate explicit g4_synergy_credit successor-phase binding; absent/False disables
api.initial_state(cfg): Create phase reservation state once; persist returned successor states across updates
api.opportunities(episodes): Extract exact accepted stochastic joint boundaries from recorded trigger slates; excludes practice/replay/deterministic/rejected/single-actuator rows
api.plan_update(cfg, update, episodes_by_arm: Return immutable-hash-bound paired full group/base/all-member-solo/two-seed job plan and next reservation state
api.execute_plan(plan, reserve=..., run_bran: Validate plan, atomically reserve all paired work via caller adapter, execute explicit worker callbacks, reject failures/partial labels without retry
api.command_offsets(job, elapsed_s, observab: Evaluate original complete move semantics and then mask commands to group/base/solo actors
api.measured_envelope(plan, results): Require complete measured SUMO branch set with exact window/capture/CRN/intervention/cost/safety bindings and compute signed seedwise synergy
api.trigger_terms(cfg, arm, update, episodes: Validate measured labels against current exact on-policy trigger records before any optimizer update; return proposer-only terms and monitoring receipt
api.ArmRuntime.train(episodes, rewards=...,: Add G4 term only to the initiating macro's trigger advantage; retain local-return advantage, critic returns, continuous residual targets, frozen base and F4

registration.sampling: Outcome-blind 1-in-16 hash of training seed/world/start/proposer; paired per-update counts matched by actor arity
registration.window: macro start through 1200s; identical pre-action state/prefix/CRN and full common horizon
registration.synergy: mean_seed(min_member J_solo - J_group); no zero floor on solo gains

verification_coverage: Complete all-member solo and both-seed enumeration; 153600/192000/230400 full-prefix quotes
Identical B/R count and branch effort, arity matching, scarcity, global sample limit and no retry/recycling
Outcome-blind deterministic sampling, exclusion of diagnostic/practice/replay/deterministic/single-actuator starts
Positive, negative, zero and all-harmful-solo cases; best solo inside each seed; bounded inherited-unit normalization
Missing, duplicate, stale, WM, ungraded, nonfinite, mismatched-window/prefix/CRN/mask/cost/safety receipt rejection
Reservation before any worker execution; budget refusal and worker failure produce no partial label
Exact original-move group/solo/base offset masks and observable wall release semantics
Real B/R PPO edge changes only proposer advantage, preserves critic returns and frozen base; invalid credit fails before optimization
Existing backend, observable reward and F4 safety regression suites
open_issues: Later integration must provide immutable pre-action captures for sampled ordinary TRAIN macro boundaries and bind the successor phase; historical cached post-action diagnostic captures are not interchangeable.

The coordinator must persist reservation state, reject duplicate plan IDs and reserve the complete paired quote in the existing overall run ledger before dispatch. The G4 cap is not additional owner budget.

An authorized production worker must implement the fixed-macro jobs on the existing replay/CRN/single-writer safety path and emit measured receipts. This task supplies job specs, exact offset masking, executor callback seam and PPO consumption; it does not install a collector/launcher or execute SUMO.
CPU verification uses explicit synthetic counterfactual receipt doubles. No measured physics or learning-effectiveness claim is made.
